Please try these searches using websearch/webfetch/bash tools. Note that these tools sometimes have intermittent permission errors - if they fail, try again after a moment.

Please:
1. Search for "GameGrumps Mario Kart 8 Deluxe May 14 2017" on YouTube
2. Identify which track they're racing on at the 2-minute mark
3. Search for the 150cc world record for that track on speedrun.com or mkwrs.com as of June 2023

Report the track name and world record time.
